purpose: Feasibility pilot for task-conditioned observation/action contracts and passive GP monitoring on two held-out LIBERO configurations.

environment.note: OSMesa rasterization differs from the UCL EGL benchmark renderer; results remain separately identified as BEAST.

fixed_tasks.instruction: pick up the black bowl next to the ramekin and place it on the plate
pick up the black bowl in the top drawer of the wooden cabinet and place it on the plate

analysis_rules: Keep the original 20-episode task-0 evidence immutable.
Do not pool BEAST and UCL results.
Preserve all successes, failures, timeouts, and runtime errors.
Do not use pilot outcomes to claim calibration or task-risk discrimination.
Do not evaluate AUROC if only one independently labeled task-outcome class is observed.
